author: Disney
description:
The Movie Surfers are back for another episode, with “Moana.” Take a stroll down the beaches of Oahu with Dwayne Johnson (Maui) and learn what it means to bring his character of Maui to life in live action. Afterwards, Michelle Khare (@MichelleKhare) hops in the car for a road trip with Catherine Laga’aia (Moana) as they break down what it was like to step into the shoes of such a storied character and take a ride on Maui’s boat. Finally, the Surfers are joined by the movie’s choreographer, Tiana Liufau, to get a lesson in hula.

Watch Disney “Moana” only in theaters on July 10.  Get tickets now:
https://www.fandango.com/moana-2026-243429/movie-overview

Disney’s “Movie Surfers” goes behind the scenes of Disney’s newest movies, giving fans access to exclusive interviews, red carpets, set tours, and more.
